# Cedar pulse dashboard export

Invented synthetic local measurement. Record state: unreviewed draft.

Run CP-31; synthetic clock window 10:00:00 through 10:10:00; 400 fabricated sensor events. Overall p95 event latency: 147 milliseconds.

The export contains only the overall latency, not per-worker latency or electrical power. This record does not supersede the bench notebook. It contains no reconciliation notes.
